name: multitask_textqa_benchmark
description: A multitask text question-answering benchmark that aggregates diverse QA datasets to measure a model's ability to answer questions across formats and domains. It evaluates both extractive and generative QA behavior under a unified evaluation suite, enabling comparison of models on multiple QA styles. The benchmark is intended to stress cross-task generalization and robustness in text-only QA settings.
reputation: A niche, task-aggregated QA benchmark with modest adoption for multitask QA evaluations but not as widely cited as major QA suites like SQuAD or NaturalQuestions.
